Mortgage Overpayment Calculator

If you can afford to pay a little more than your mortgage asks for each month, it's worth doing. Interest is charged on what you still owe, so every extra pound you put in early reduces what you're charged in every month that follows.
blocks.2:
Why Overpay?

Most UK lenders will let you overpay up to 10% of your outstanding balance each year without triggering an early repayment charge, though it's worth checking your own lender's terms.

  • Reduce the Term: Clear your debt faster and own your home outright sooner.
  • Save Interest: What you save is tax-free, and it often beats what you'd get from a savings account.
  • Better LTV: Bringing your balance down faster can help you qualify for a cheaper rate when you next remortgage.
